SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-03-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT HEARING RE PARTIES' SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT TO OCT-08-2024 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY RYON HAYWARD (CLAIMS INVESTIGATOR). DEFENDANT ARLENE LUGO IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS LUIS RODRIGUEZ. THE PARTIES REACHED A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT THE TERMS OF WHICH ARE THAT DEFENDANT ARLENE LUGO IS TO PAY PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO $1000.00 (WHICH INCLUDES ANY COURT COSTS). PAYMENTS ARE TO BE MADE BY DEFENDANT IN MONTHLY INSTALLMENTS OF $100.00 EACH MONTH FOR 10 MONTHS. IF NO APPEARANCES ARE MADE AT THE PROGRESS REPORT HEARING, THE COURT WILL DISMISS THIS CASE WITH PREJUDICE PER THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PARTIES ARE TO APPEAR AT THE PROGRESS REPORT HEARING IF THE TERMS OF THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT HAVE NOT BEEN COMPLIED WITH, AT WHICH TIME THE COURT WILL ENTER JUDGMENT AGAINST DEFENDANT IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,000.00 LESS ANY PAYMENTS MADE UP TO THAT DATE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MARGARET WU; CLERK: S. KANE. NOT REPORTED. (D506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LUGO, ARLENE $800.00 PRINCIPAL, $122.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $922.50, PLAINTIFF APPEARED TO REPORT THAT DEFENDANT DID NOT COMPLETE PAYMENTS PER RESOLUTION.
